group: Test addMatchReferences with Exact and Similar Patterns

cases.expected: No change in hasNumeric, hasIP, hasSuffix
cases.description: Test with an EXACT pattern. No counters should increment.

cases.expected: No change in hasNumeric, hasIP, hasSuffix
cases.description: Test with a PREFIX pattern. No counters should increment.
Test with a SUFFIX pattern. hasSuffix should increment.
Test with a NUMERIC_EQ pattern. hasNumeric should increment.
Test with a NUMERIC_RANGE pattern that is not CIDR. hasNumeric should increment.
Test with a NUMERIC_RANGE pattern that is CIDR. hasIP should increment.

group: Test addMatchReferences with Anything But Patterns

cases.description: Test with an ANYTHING_BUT pattern. hasNumeric should increment and anythingButs should increase.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_IGNORE_CASE pattern. anythingButs should increase, but hasNumeric should not.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_SUFFIX pattern. hasSuffix should increment and anythingButs should increase.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_PREFIX pattern. anythingButs should increase.
Test with an undefined pattern type. Should throw an AssertionError.

cases.expected: No change in hasNumeric, hasIP, hasSuffix
cases.description: Test with a WILDCARD pattern. No counters should increment.

group: Test addMatchReferences with Equals Ignore Case Pattern

cases.expected: No change in hasNumeric, hasIP, hasSuffix
cases.description: Test with an EQUALS_IGNORE_CASE pattern. No counters should increment.

group: Test addMatchReferences with Anything But Numeric Pattern

cases.description: Test with an ANYTHING_BUT pattern. hasNumeric should increment and anythingButs should increase.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_IGNORE_CASE pattern. anythingButs should increase, but hasNumeric should not.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_SUFFIX pattern. hasSuffix should increment and anythingButs should increase.
Test with an ANYTHING_BUT_PREFIX pattern. anythingButs should increase.
